Make sure SOS calls wake you

  1. Download the MMHotline contact card and add the MMHotline contact to your contacts.
  2. Allow the MMHotline contact through Do Not Disturb. On iPhone, also turn on Emergency Bypass for the MMHotline contact.
  3. Turn on Do Not Disturb and press “Send test” on your automated voice call panel.

Alerts to send through the contact method

Add a contact method

Saving a new contact method queues a test. Alerts can use the saved contact method immediately.

Which alerts should I choose?

Info is for information only. Warning needs attention but wakes nobody. An SOS is urgent and wakes the person on call until someone claims the incident.

Each contact method also receives messages when the selected alerts are resolved.

MMHotline sends each alert as signed JSON in a POST request to a public HTTPS URL.

Alerts to send through the contact method

Add a phone number

MMHotline calls your number when an SOS needs you. Adding a phone number queues a test call.

By adding this number you agree to get alert calls from MMHotline.

Add Pushover notification

Use your personal Pushover user key. Saving sends a quiet test notification. The saved contact method then shows how to check that an SOS wakes this phone. Acknowledging an SOS in Pushover also claims the incident for you.

Leave the device name empty to send to all your devices. Name one device to send only to it.
